title: Jula Evidence
description: Schema for evidence files consumed by the Jula Assessor. Any tool producing evidence for Jula must conform to this shape.

evidence_id.description: Evidence Request List identifier (e.g., 'EVID-BCM-16'). Primary routing key for the assessment pipeline.

control_id.description: Generic control identifier (e.g., 'BCD-11.4', 'ac-1'). Maps to the OSCAL control ID.

source_id.description: Resource source identifier (e.g., GCP project ID, AWS account ID).

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of finding.raw_data, providing cryptographic proof of exact collected data.
